entries.title: Dracodia / physical ninja dives and alternating claw slashes
entries.note: Live native Furious final-main-life checkpoint: full5330HP and intact limbs, prior copied lives cleared before filming. GOD plus input-only aiming; no recorder HP/phase/timer writes during footage. Shows both slash orders and native main-life defeat, then the opening of final destruction. Broken-claw cancellation is tested separately.
